C04.name: Anubis
C04.decision: User-selected 2026-10-03: accepted direction is tall, narrow, non-human funerary organism; restrained linen sash; ankh-topped funerary staff; black funerary morphology. Base only, not LOCKED.
C04.not_base: 02_Gods/Anubis/REF_GOD_Anubis_Hero_v02.png is NOT the continuity base; kept unchanged on disk as a historical/superseded reference (not deleted).
C04.preserve: the staff geometry exactly as in Hero Master v02 (the staff geometry authority): one straight single shaft, an ankh top, and one lower crossbar with hanging linen strips; no additional crossbars and no split or twin shaft (Anubis Materials v01 staff is NOT authoritative). Tall narrow non-human funerary organism, restrained linen sash, black funerary morphology.

cross_asset_rules.name: Sheut
cross_asset_rules.rule: CROSS-ASSET SHEUT RULE (applies to every asset whose image includes Sheut): whenever Sheut appears, Sheut is Nefer's flat-black autonomous shadow / soul-function, drawn as a flat cast or detached shadow lying on or rising from a surface with physically readable connection logic (a shadow line or contact point). Never a solid human body, never a muscular or sculpted black figure, never a woman, no independent face or facial features, no smoke, no wisps, no ghost, no generic shadow monster.
